id.description: A UUID string identifying this replay scanner.

max_score.description: Scorer scanners only: count sessions scoring at or below this value.

min_score.description: Scorer scanners only: count sessions scoring at or above this value. Scorers require `min_score` and/or `max_score`. Not applicable to other scanner types.

tag.description: Classifier scanners only, required for them: count sessions carrying this tag (fixed or freeform). Not applicable to other scanner types.

window_days.description: Trailing window of observations to count. Defaults to 30 days.
